designs.name: one-shot prepared result bound to future descriptor
designs.normal_problem: HERO future host stripe is addressable before current SPM owner releases; prewarming could lose residency and pinning could consume shared capacity
designs.residual_after_warm_pwc: not established; must preserve same actual A/B/C work and allowed mapping/PWC configuration
designs.new_capability_proposed: keep a formally valid one-shot future result outside shared IOTLB and hand it to exact native owner only after application release and real acceptance
designs.capacity: K counts pending + ready + fault; every accepted request has result sink; no implicit extra descriptor or table
designs.source_new_fact: default HERO stripe is 16384B; under 4KiB mapping 4 pages if aligned, otherwise 5; actual alignment/page size unknown; hero_dma_job_t contains only uint32_t id and t+2 is not yet submitted
protocol: register immutable span/context/required permissions/source/generation and reserve credit
return successful checked permission or owned fault
application release does not constitute hardware acceptance
adopt exact request before mutable first VALID boundary and only on real sink acceptance
hold VALID payload stable and preserve old owner until transfer succeeds
release translation use independently of R/W/B/consumer/buffer retirement
invalidation blocks unused adoption; accepted obligations remain owned
allow legitimate consumed-field and future-consumer lifecycle reuse for both implementations
nearest_prior: P1 ICCD2018 progress-limited pure prefetch and burst retirement
R2 ATS translation/access separation and ATC invalidation
ordinary_controls: O-DBG: existing trusted debug prewarm plus ordinary native lookup, fully charged
O-PIN: same paid registration, only live translation uses pinned, early release allowed
O-PAQ-D: same finite result pool and exact descriptor/context/range/epoch matching; ring/handle/field recycling allowed
local ATC/ATS adaptation and legal PWC/large-page/resident mappings
designs.ordinary_implementation_status: specified state machine only; no code or new execution; not a full exception equivalence proof
designs.positive_prediction: if an actual future stripe loses useful translation after paid prewarming and that replay blocks full matrix completion, retained valid results can hide some post-release translation; O-PIN/O-PAQ-D share this ability
designs.adjacent_counterexample: same program normal stripe with no intervening relevant eviction or PTE warm/compute overlap already hides translation; added interface is pure cost
designs.specific_failed_claim: reuse of current future-descriptor storage eliminates extra prepared-result storage
designs.failure_reason: current source has only job ID and computable future address; 4/5-page result container not already present. Reusing ID as handle still needs charged table and is equally available to O-PAQ-D
designs.preserved_claim: a concrete cheaper or more deployable on-chip interface can still be a system contribution if demonstrated; ordinary same-interface implementation does not deny it
designs.minimum_decisive_evidence: one actual future stripe residency/storage card with source a/r events, keys/last uses, residual under PWC/prewarm and concrete field/port ownership for B1-D, O-PAQ-D and O-PIN

designs.name: interruptible speculative preparation with bounded return
designs.normal_problem: a prepare admitted before a demand can occupy the shared walker after demand becomes eligible
designs.new_capability_proposed: after current irrevocable PTE retires, suspend finite prepare context and serve demand; resume with progress
designs.actual_production_capability: no suspend interface; normal TC translation response is always ready so payload does not pin shared TL response
invariants: suspend only after PTE checks and before next first VALID
finite J frames and terminal sinks
explicit progress share for prepare under continuing demand
no added walker hidden in context count
nearest_prior: R4 prior per-PTE tracking and checkpoint
ordinary_controls: O-CKPT: same finite contexts/fields/priority/progress rule at same PTE boundaries
O-GR: retain S prefix, replay current G child under explicit progress condition
same-budget partial/path PWC and legal variable storage
designs.positive_prediction: demand behind nonterminal prepare can start earlier than under whole-walk policy, after committed PTE residual; O-CKPT has same action
designs.adjacent_counterexample: current PTE is leaf or committed transaction dominates residual; context switch adds overhead; full frame pool forbids further acceptance
designs.failure_reason: proposed service action reduces to concrete checkpoint and priority/progress implementation; no source-bound committed obligation or complete cost point distinguishes candidate; fake TL response backpressure is excluded by current TC
designs.scope_not_closed: dynamic arrivals, PTE paths and PWC complete cost frontier; no global ordinary optimality claim

c2p1_short_note.ordinary_comparison: same-information event recurrence with dependency/order/credit-release edges; finite-state exploration when choices change future graph
c2p1_short_note.minimum_evidence: one normal source-reachable full-return blocking segment violating the selected TC premise, adjacent changed-return-capacity segment, and a reusable analysis producing useful decision beyond direct recurrence
